title: B6 fix round: challenge base falls to goal/<parent>; 6.x placeholders carry quota_group (review T-0030)
spec:
Why: review T-0030 on B6 commit 3808258 returned request_changes (full text: /Users/k3ntaw/code/orchestrator/.orchestrator/tasks/T-0030.json). (MED) spawn.base_for: challenge tasks have inputs[0] = {claim, evidence, confidence} (a dict), so the isinstance(str) branch never fires and every challenge worktree falls back to origin/main while README claims otherwise. (LOW) .orchestrator/pool.toml: disabled rows luna6/terra6/sol6 omit quota_group, so enabling one later would break group cooling.

What (3 files: orchestrator/spawn.py, .orchestrator/pool.toml, tests/test_orchestrator.py, plus the one README sentence): this worktree branches from task/T-0029 so B6's code is present.
1. spawn.base_for: for role challenge (inputs[0] a dict or absent) return `goal/<parent>` when that branch exists, else origin/main; keep the review path (inputs[0] a task id string → task/<id> → goal/<src parent> → origin/main). README sentence: "review worktrees base on the reviewed task's branch; challenge worktrees on the goal branch; reviews prefer the other account."
2. pool.toml: add `quota_group = "chatgpt"` to luna6, terra6 and sol6.
3. tests: base_for(challenge task with dict inputs and an existing goal branch) == goal/<parent>; without the goal branch → origin/main. Assert every [[executors]] row in the TMP pool.toml has a non-empty quota_group.

Run `uv run python -m unittest tests/test_orchestrator.py`. Commit: "spawn: challenge worktrees base on the goal branch; 6.x executor placeholders carry quota_group (review T-0030)" with a revert-path body.
acceptance: uv run python -m unittest tests/test_orchestrator.py exits 0 with the new base_for(challenge) and quota_group tests
every [[executors]] row in .orchestrator/pool.toml has quota_group set
README sentence distinguishes review and challenge bases
git diff --stat limited to orchestrator/spawn.py, .orchestrator/pool.toml, tests/test_orchestrator.py, README.md

result.summary:
## Summary

Fixed review T-0030's finding: `base_for` shared a single `isinstance(str)` check between review and challenge roles, but challenge tasks pass `inputs[0]` as a dict (`{claim, evidence, confidence}`), so the check never fired and challenge worktrees silently fell back to `origin/main` instead of the goal branch. Split the challenge path into its own branch in `orchestrator/spawn.py`: challenge (and execute) now base on `goal/<parent>` when it exists, else `origin/main`; review keeps its own task-branch-based logic unchanged.

`.orchestrator/pool.toml` already had `quota_group = "chatgpt"` on the `luna6`/`terra6`/`sol6` rows in this worktree (it branches from task/T-0029, which already carried the fix upstream) — no change needed there, but added a test guarding it doesn't regress.

**Files changed:**
- `orchestrator/spawn.py` — `base_for`: challenge role gets its own goal-branch-or-origin-main path
- `tests/test_orchestrator.py` — `test_challenge_bases_on_goal_branch`, `test_every_executor_row_has_a_quota_group`
- `README.md` — sentence now distinguishes review vs. challenge worktree bases

**Test output:** `uv run python -m unittest tests/test_orchestrator.py` → 41 tests, OK (no failures). `.claude/hooks/tests-green.sh` → exit 0.

Committed on `task/T-0032` as `7b0e2ef`. `git diff --stat` for the commit is limited to the three scoped files (pool.toml needed no changes, matching acceptance criteria).
result.review: other account, different model; label PR same-family-review
